page_title: EMP 0-1 INT | Empoli v Inter 24/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+2' A corner kick by Empoli is thwarted by the well prepared Yann Sommer (Inter).
90+2' Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender. Empoli force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
90+1' Marko Arnautovic (Inter) looks like he won’t be able to continue.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' The game is interrupted now, Marko Arnautovic (Inter) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
89' Empoli fail to score from a corner as Yann Sommer (Inter) leaps to collect the ball.
89' Tommaso Baldanzi (Empoli) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender. The referee points to the corner flag and Empoli will take a corner.
89' Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
87' Inter are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
86' The corner is swung in but Inter can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
81' The game has come to an end for Federico Dimarco. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Carlos Augusto (Inter).
81' Simone Inzaghi decides to make a substitution. Marcus Thuram will be replaced by Alexis Sanchez (Inter).
79' Aurelio Andreazzoli has decided to make a change. Mattia Destro (Empoli) replaces Nicolo Cambiaghi.
79' Substitution. Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli) replaces Stiven Shpendi.
78' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
74' Marko Arnautovic (Inter) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
71' A substitution has been made. Alessandro Bastoni is replaced by Stefan de Vrij (Inter).
71' Substitution. Nicolo Barella (Inter) in, Davide Frattesi out.
71' Simone Inzaghi has decided to substitute Lautaro Martinez and he is replaced by Marko Arnautovic (Inter).
70' Tommaso Baldanzi (Empoli) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
69' Here is a change. Filippo Ranocchia is going off and Aurelio Andreazzoli gives the last tactical orders to Alberto Grassi (Empoli).
69' It's time for a substitution. Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli) comes on in place of Razvan Marin.
67' A cross into the box from Davide Frattesi (Inter) is cleared.
66' A snap shot by Filippo Ranocchia (Empoli) from the edge of the area flies towards the top right corner, but Yann Sommer produces a good reflex save to thwart him.
65' Empoli have a free kick from a promising distance.
65' It's like he was asking for a caution. Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) receives a yellow card.
62' A yellow card for a tackle by Youssef Maleh (Empoli). Matteo Marcenaro doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
57' Inter take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
57' Marcus Thuram (Inter) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. Inter win a corner.

55' Filippo Ranocchia (Empoli) was too forceful with his tackle and Matteo Marcenaro interrupted the game to signal a free kick. It's a free kick to Inter, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.

51' 0 - 1 Federico Dimarco (Inter) quickly gets to a rebound. He is not worried how far out he is and slams the ball towards the goal. To the amazement of all, it goes all the way into the top right corner. He makes it 0:1 with this magnificent strike.
51' Substitution. Sebastian Walukiewicz (Empoli) on for Ardian Ismajli.
50' The ball is out of play. Inter will have a chance to score from a corner.

50' Federico Dimarco (Inter) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but Etrit Berisha has it covered and makes a comfortable save. Corner kick. Inter will have an opportunity.
49' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
47' Stiven Shpendi (Empoli) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it goes well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Inter.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+1' Matteo Marcenaro blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
44' Davide Frattesi (Inter) has an effort from the edge of the area, but he skies the ball over the top. The ball goes out of play and Empoli will have a goal kick.
42' That was close. Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) fires a shot from the edge of the box which goes a whisker wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Empoli will have a goal kick.
40' A weak shot from the edge of the box by Davide Frattesi (Inter) is easily saved by Etrit Berisha.
38' Etrit Berisha pulls off a good save to deny a long-range header from Marcus Thuram (Inter). Great goalkeeping!
37' Razvan Marin (Empoli) gets a shot away from distance, but wasn't really set to take it and fires high and wide. The ball goes out of play and Inter will have a goal kick.
35' A goal, which was scored by Marcus Thuram (Inter), was disallowed due to offside.
35' Inter take a short corner kick.
34' Federico Dimarco (Inter) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.
33' Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) attempts to discuss the decision with Matteo Marcenaro, but he soon realises that it's not the right thing to do as he sees the yellow.

33' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Inter will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
33' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
31' Federico Dimarco (Inter) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
30' Ardian Ismajli (Empoli) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
29' Federico Dimarco (Inter) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
26' Matteo Marcenaro shows a yellow card to Francesco Acerbi (Inter), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
23' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
20' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
19' Razvan Marin (Empoli) commits a rough foul. Matteo Marcenaro stops the game and makes a call.
15' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Inter comes to nothing.
13' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) hits a good looking first-time shot from the edge of the box, but it goes narrowly over the bar.
12' Federico Dimarco (Inter) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the right side of the goal, but Etrit Berisha has it covered and makes a comfortable save.

11' Matteo Darmian (Inter) latched on to a cross inside the six-yard box and headed at goal. If it wasn't for one of the defenders making a save on the goal line, he would have been celebrating a goal now.
6' Matteo Darmian (Inter) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
6' Razvan Marin (Empoli) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Matteo Marcenaro saw the whole situation.
4' Empoli failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
3' That's a well-taken pass by Davide Frattesi (Inter). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Empoli.
1' The match has just started.
Inter will kick-off.
Matteo Marcenaro is the one to supervise the game today.
